text:
claire: Heads-up: external pen test booked Fri 2026-06-11 09:00-15:00 PT. Need concise runbook covering: ephemeral RBAC, KMS grant scoping, immutable log snapshot, remediation tracker, and retest scheduling.

sania: Ok. Scope?

claire: Only staging and canary-prod path. No full-prod. Scope doc on vault internal link.

ben: RBAC plan: create pt-assessor-<id> role, TTL=4h, CLI/API only, deny console. Approver: @sania.

sania: Approve in principle. KMS: allow kms:Decrypt for logs only, explicitly deny kms:CreateGrant and kms:CreateKey. Audit GrantCreate/Retire events.

evidence-bot: Ticket SEC-PT-2026-0611 created. Evidence prefix s3://redwood-pt-evidence/SEC-PT-2026-0611/<finding>/

claire: Packaging: presigned uploads + manifest.csv (finding, service, pr, deploy-id, logs-path, sha256). Ben, can you share a minimal IAM snippet for ops?

ben: Short example: {"Action":["logs:GetLogEvents","s3:GetObject","kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:logs:*:*:*"} (ops to formalize)

sania: Retention: immutable archive for 90 days, 14-day hot SIEM window. Export to s3://redwood-pt-archives/SEC-PT-2026-0611/YYYYMMDD/

claire: Triage: 0-24h security on-call (sania) triages and assigns. 24-72h eng owners implement & upload evidence. Criticals target 48h patch.

ben: Retest cadence: open window 7 days after report upload. Reserve two 2-hour slots/week for 2 weeks. Vendor books slot via tracker.

deploy-bot: If you post role name I can pre-create presigned URLs and whitelist IPs. Use `!prepare <role>` here.

sania: One constraint: no key rotations during the engagement unless approved by security and SRE.

claire: Action items:
- sania: sign ephemeral role + KMS constraints (TODAY)
- ben: IAM snippet + QA regression checklist (EOD)
- deploy-bot: prepare presigned URL flow when role name provided
- claire: set retest slots in tracker and notify vendor

ben: Quick Q: do assessors need CloudTrail full view or filtered exports?

sania: Give filtered read-only CloudTrail view; full exports go to the archive bucket.

claire: I'll write the short runbook and drop in #incidents once role and presign flow are ready. React with :white_check_mark: when done.

sania: :white_check_mark:

ben: :white_check_mark:
